FERRET.evidence: Fixed-coordinate Planck R3/WMAP9 HiPS2FITS products retrieved read-only with SHA-256 receipts.

HUMMINGBIRD.evidence: Target coordinate, map identities, hashes, 40 arcmin common beam and fixed T36 layout are recorded.

evidence: Target was fixed before the CMB null scan.
Controls use the same Galactic latitude and exclude +/-30 degrees around the target longitude.
Target lies close to the Galactic plane, so foreground structure remains a major confounder.

evidence.interpretation: Shared morphology in frequency maps does not by itself identify a PBH and is compatible with foreground-dominated structure near the Galactic plane.

BELZEBUB.evidence: Matched-latitude controls frequently equal or exceed the target T36 Moire statistic.

GREMLIN.scope: This rejects only the present degree-scale Planck/WMAP phase-marker candidate. It does not reject the independent orbital PBH hypothesis.

next_gate.name: INDEPENDENT_SMALL_SCALE_LENSING_OR_ASTROMETRIC_TEST
next_gate.reason: A Solar-System PBH of the historical mass scale would have a milliarcsecond-scale Einstein angle, far below Planck/WMAP beam scales; a direct test requires appropriate high-resolution astrometric/lensing data rather than degree-scale CMB morphology.
